Revenue is earned through wholesale sales of packaged snack and candy products, recently broadened by the 2021 acquisitions of Pretzels, Dots and Lily's Sweets [c1].

presentation.intro: These are the company's own reported results for the year just ended; read them separately from what the valuation panel says about the price paid for them.

metrics.label: Revenue
metrics.context: Consolidated FY2022 net sales, up 16.1% year over year; organic growth of 12.0% split 8.0 points price realization and 4.0 points volume/mix. Price, not volume, drove most of the increase.

metrics.label: Gross margin
metrics.context: GAAP gross profit as a percent of FY2022 net sales; down from 45.1% in FY2021. Q4 alone slipped 30 basis points as cost-of-goods inflation outpaced price increases.

metrics.label: Operating margin
metrics.context: GAAP operating profit as a percent of FY2022 net sales, down from 22.8% in FY2021 despite higher sales, reflecting cost inflation that outpaced price gains.

metrics.label: Free cash flow
metrics.context: Not disclosed: the Feb 2023 release includes only an income statement and balance sheet, no cash-flow statement, and the FY2022 10-K had not yet been filed at cutoff.

metrics.label: Net debt
metrics.metric: Net debt (total debt minus cash, Dec 31, 2022)
metrics.context: Total debt minus cash at Dec 31, 2022, down from $4,699.6 million a year earlier as debt fell and cash rose. Does not include off-balance-sheet obligations.

presentation.valuation_context: The revenue multiple uses FY2021 net sales ($8,971.3 million), not the higher FY2022 figure the tile above shows. Share count is from Dec 31, 2021, over a year before the Feb 2023 price; net-debt inputs are dated Dec 31, 2022.

what_changed.fact: Full-year 2022 net sales were $10,419.3 million, up 16.1%, with organic constant-currency growth of 12.0% (8.0 points of net price realization plus 4.0 points of volume/mix) [c2].
what_changed.relationship_to_business: This is the company's core annual revenue result, showing pricing and volume both contributed to growth despite an inflationary cost environment.

what_changed.fact: The company issued 2023 full-year guidance of 6%-8% net sales growth and 9%-11% adjusted EPS growth, a deceleration from 2022's 16.1% sales growth and 18.5% adjusted EPS growth [c3].
what_changed.relationship_to_business: Management's own forward guidance sets the growth bar the market will measure the business against for the next fiscal year.

what_changed.fact: The North America Salty Snacks segment grew full-year net sales 85.3% (aided by 2021 acquisitions) while the International segment's full-year margin improved to 12.6% from 10.1% [c4].
what_changed.relationship_to_business: Shows the two smaller segments -- recently acquired salty snacks and international -- both expanded in 2022, changing the company's growth and margin mix beyond core North America confectionery.

sector_evidence.guidance_table_note: No 'prior guidance' column is populated: the release compares 2023 guidance against 2022's actual growth rates, not against a previously issued 2022 guidance figure, and an earlier 2022-guidance release is not in this evidence packet.

competitive_position_facts.fact: US candy/mint/gum (CMG) retail takeaway (MULO+C channels, 12 weeks ended Jan 1, 2023) rose 10.7% year-over-year, while CMG category share fell 54 basis points on category-mix headwinds and capacity constraints on seasonal products.
US salty-snack retail takeaway (same 12-week window) rose 19.2%, with the company's salty-snack category share up 10 basis points.
The SkinnyPop brand's retail sales rose 19.7%, gaining 130 basis points of ready-to-eat popcorn category share.
The Dots Homestyle Pretzels brand's retail sales rose 32.3%, gaining 130 basis points of pretzel category share.
US chocolate retail sales grew 10.6% in the same window.
US refreshment (mints/gum) retail sales grew 10.8% in the same window.

catalysts.description: 2023 capacity expansion and an ERP-system build funded by $800-900 million of guided capital expenditure [c5].

unresolved_questions: Whether continued net price realization can sustain revenue growth at the guided pace if consumer price sensitivity increases in 2023.
Whether input-cost and labor inflation will move in line with, above, or below the margin assumptions embedded in the 6%-8% sales growth and 9%-11% adjusted EPS guidance.
Whether the North America Salty Snacks segment can sustain its 2022 organic growth and margin expansion as the 2021 acquisitions lap and promotional spending normalizes.

macro_context.item: Management characterized 2022 as achieved despite record inflation, continued supply-chain disruptions and macroeconomic uncertainty for consumers [c6].
macro_context.business_connection: Higher input, packaging and labor costs raise cost of goods sold and pressure gross margin unless offset by price increases or volume leverage.

macro_context.item: 2023 guidance embeds interest expense of approximately $145-155 million, which the company said reflects a higher interest-rate environment [c7].
macro_context.business_connection: Higher benchmark interest rates raise the cost of the company's short-term and floating-rate debt, reducing net income available after interest expense.

own: Full-year 2022 net sales and adjusted EPS grew 16.1% and 18.5% respectively even as management cited record input-cost inflation, evidence of realized pricing power [c8].
2023 guidance of 6%-8% sales growth and 9%-11% adjusted EPS growth, while slower than 2022, is still an above-average growth range for consumer staples [c9].

The North America Salty Snacks segment's fourth-quarter margin expanded 840 basis points to 20.8% as the 2021 acquisitions integrated, adding a second profit engine alongside core confectionery [c10].
flat: 2023 guidance itself embeds a deceleration to single-digit sales growth and continued cost pressure, alongside higher planned interest expense and capital spending [c11].
Reported gross margin already declined 30 basis points to 43.2% in the fourth quarter of 2022, as broad-based cost-of-goods inflation outpaced price realization [c12].
short: Planned 2023 capital expenditure of $800-900 million and interest expense of $145-155 million represent a step-up in cash outflow that could pressure free cash flow if growth decelerates faster than guided [c13].
US candy/mint/gum retail category share fell 54 basis points in the most recent 12-week read even as price-led retail sales rose 10.7%, a sign that price increases may be ceding unit share [c14].
